configurations.name: tionharness-mac
runtimeArgs: v=github.com/bilal-arikan/tionharness/internal/api; c=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); mkdir -p bin && go build -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X $v.BuildCommit=$c -X $v.BuildDate=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" -o bin/tionharness ./cmd/tionharness && TIONHARNESS_ADDR=127.0.0.1:5173 TIONHARNESS_ENABLE_SHELL=1 exec bin/tionharness

configurations.name: tionharness-mac-dev
runtimeArgs: v=github.com/bilal-arikan/tionharness/internal/api; c=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); mkdir -p bin && go build -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X $v.BuildCommit=$c -X $v.BuildDate=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" -o bin/tionharness-dev ./cmd/tionharness && TIONHARNESS_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8090 TIONHARNESS_ENABLE_SHELL=1 exec bin/tionharness-dev

configurations.name: tionharness-mac-scratch
runtimeArgs: v=github.com/bilal-arikan/tionharness/internal/api; c=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); mkdir -p bin "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/th-scratch-data" && go build -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X $v.BuildCommit=$c -X $v.BuildDate=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" -o bin/tionharness-scratch ./cmd/tionharness && TIONHARNESS_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8091 TIONHARNESS_DATA_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/th-scratch-data" TIONHARNESS_ENABLE_SHELL=1 exec bin/tionharness-scratch
